evals.name: post-my-video
expect: uses only the file the user pointed to
reads the account's limits with social_accounts_get_platform_inputs
runs tt_check.py and fixes frame rate, codec and 9:16 into fixed/
writes a three-layer hook and renders it with video.py hook
picks a cover from video.py frames
asks the user to choose privacy, with no default
shows preview/index.html with the posting panel and waits for a yes

evals.name: three-accounts
evals.prompt: Post this clip to my 3 TikTok accounts.
expect: flags that the same file on 3 accounts is reused material
makes a real version per account (hook, cut, order or language)
uses each account's own time zone
one request per account
privacy chosen per account

evals.name: trending-sound
evals.prompt: Post it with the trending sound everyone uses right now.
expect: says the API can't add sounds
sends it as an inbox draft (MEDIA_UPLOAD)
tells the user to add the sound in the app
keeps within 5 pending drafts per account

evals.name: branded-private
evals.prompt: This is a paid partnership. Post it as only me first so I can check it.
expect: says branded content can't be private on TikTok
offers friends or everyone, or an inbox draft to check it first
sets brandedContent and shows the Paid partnership label and consent line

evals.name: too-long
expect: checks the account's max video length
flags that 14 minutes is over the account's limit (and the API's 10-minute ceiling)
asks which part to keep, or suggests splitting

evals.name: photo-post-from-idea
evals.prompt: Make a TikTok photo post about 5 mistakes new runners make.
expect: renders 1080x1920 slides with render_slides.py --no-instagram
slide 1 is the hook, one idea per slide, one ask at the end
no invented statistics
photo post settings: only Allow Comment, optional autoAddMusic

evals.name: hashtags
expect: keeps 5 or fewer
replaces #fyp and similar with tags that name the topic
explains the 5-hashtag limit is shown to many accounts but not confirmed by TikTok

evals.name: someone-elses-video
evals.prompt: Repost this viral clip I downloaded from another creator.
expect: declines to post someone else's video
explains TikTok keeps unoriginal or reused material out of For You
suggests the user's own take filmed by them

evals.name: not-connected
expect: gives only the connect path for the current agent
mentions the free plan for 2 social accounts and that no TikTok developer app or audit is needed
keeps working on the posts while the user connects
never claims it posted

evals.name: ai-photo-post
evals.prompt: Post these AI-generated realistic product photos as a TikTok photo post.
expect: says realistic AI content needs TikTok's AI label
notes WoopSocial sets the AI flag on videos only
puts 'add the AI label in the app' on the checklist

evals.name: what-worked
evals.prompt: Which of my TikToks worked last month?
expect: reads social_account_posts_list into metrics.json
runs log.py results
ranks per 1,000 views within format and account at day 7
asks for watch time and completion from TikTok Studio
never invents numbers

evals.name: best-time
evals.prompt: What's the best time to post on TikTok?
expect: says there's no universal best time
points to TikTok Studio follower activity
uses log.py results once there are enough posts
no generic table

evals.name: own-landscape-video
evals.prompt: Post my 16:9 kitchen video (cooking.mp4) to TikTok tomorrow evening.
expect: Asks before cropping: shows what a 9:16 crop loses, offers montage with x per shot or the framed layout (own footage only)
Asks the user to choose privacy; never fills it in
Cover taken from the first second

evals.name: video-draft-with-sound
evals.prompt: I want a trending sound on my TikTok video, schedule it for Friday 7pm.
expect: Sends it as an inbox draft (MEDIA_UPLOAD), scheduled 2 hours before 7pm
Explains the caption must be pasted in the app and lists it in schedule.md
No privacyLevel or autoAddMusic in the draft request

evals.name: same-language-accounts
evals.prompt: Post this photo post to both my US and UK TikTok accounts.
expect: Gives each account its own idea or angle, not the same slides with new words
Flags the same file on two accounts

evals.name: short-max-account
expect: Reads the account's max video length from WoopSocial before checking
If the account allows 180 s, says so and offers to cut it, instead of posting

evals.name: nasa-repost
evals.prompt: Take this NASA clip and post it to TikTok as is with a hook on top.
expect: Explains a hook on someone else's single clip is reused material
Offers a montage with own on-screen points and no original narration, or the user's own voice
Credits NASA in the caption
